'''Orth Quane''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the fledgling [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during its first days on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. A devotee of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rajivari]], Quane and several other apprentices abandoned the Order to follow Master Rajivari in his attempts to destroy an Order he saw as plagued by mediocrity.<ref name="TOR" />
